_about: The three Always Free sessions offered on wehale.io/breathe. A session is playable when public/breathe/sessions/<slug>/score.json and audio.mp3 both exist at build time; until then its choice shows 'Coming soon'. next_en is the end-screen suggestion after finishing it. world: the room's colour on the start screen in the landing variants (a, b, c) and during that session; v=0 keeps Ember for all. reason_en: the one reason line on the tiles in variants d and e. does_en: the tile line in variant f, what the session does, not tied to the clock. next_f_en: the end-screen suggestion in variant f (not tied to a time of day). narrator: who guides the recording (from the production database, 28 Sep: The Soft Reboot is Philip, Unravel and The Wake Up are Edvin); every name on the page follows the chosen session. web_start_f: in variant f, where playback starts (1 s before the first line that fits any moment): The Wake Up skips 'This is your morning reset.', The Soft Reboot skips 'Welcome to this breathwork session, which is designed to cultivate more peace, more calm, and a way for you to manage your stress more effectively.' Unset: the score's startAt. web_continue_f: in variant f with ?seen=round (the visitor breathed one round in the ad), playback starts here, after the introduction (1 s before the first instruction). (Variant g uses choice, narrator and the does/web_start fields; its line is the hook's, or 'Breathe with <narrator>.')
